description: A VP of Engineering must approve the production rollout plan for a new search-ranking model, setting the rollout cohort, start window, customer exclusions, audit logging, and human-review controls after the normal cross-functional readiness review.

shared_context.S1: The new search-ranking model is scheduled for its first production rollout next week.
shared_context.S2: Riley makes the binding decision on the rollout plan.
shared_context.S3: The current rollout draft enables the model for 25% of all tenants on Monday at 09:00 UTC, keeps ranking-event logs for 30 days, applies the standard automated ranking behavior to every tenant, and has no special customer-notification step.
shared_context.S4: Before the rollout plan is finalized, the release checklist requires Search Platform, SRE, Customer Success, and Compliance to report any relevant constraints and required follow-up commitments.

PF1.text: While testing tenant-specific analyzers for a separate search ticket yesterday, Mina confirmed that the new model is incompatible with the custom tokenization used by exactly three tenants: Lattice Health, Northwind Legal, and Solace Retail. Those tenants must be excluded from the first cohort, and Mina has not updated the rollout ticket because the compatibility test finished after the ticket's last review.

PF2.text: Owen confirmed 20 minutes ago that a database maintenance operation will occupy the search index cluster on Monday morning, so the model rollout must start at exactly Tuesday 02:00 UTC and use the one-hour 02:00-03:00 UTC deployment window. He has not posted the collision because the maintenance owner is still updating the operations calendar.

PF3.text: Leah found in a customer contract review this morning that Lattice Health and Northwind Legal require five business days' advance notice before an algorithmic ranking change affecting their accounts. Neither customer has been notified, and Leah has not added the clause to the engineering rollout ticket because the review was part of a separate renewal task.

PF4.text: During this quarter's audit preparation, Victor confirmed that ranking decisions for regulated tenants must have audit logs retained for exactly 180 days and must offer a human-review path; the current draft's 30-day retention and fully automated behavior do not satisfy that policy. He has not opened the compliance task because the audit evidence request arrived only this afternoon.

acceptance_conditions: The first rollout cohort must be exactly 10% of tenants.
The rollout must start at exactly Tuesday 02:00 UTC.
The excluded-tenant list must be exactly Lattice Health, Northwind Legal, and Solace Retail.
Ranking-event logs must be retained for exactly 180 days.
A human-review path must be enabled.

decisive_facts.why: The custom-tokenization finding changes the excluded-tenant list from none to exactly Lattice Health, Northwind Legal, and Solace Retail and adds the compatibility-exclusion commitment.
The database-maintenance collision changes the rollout start from Monday 09:00 UTC to exactly Tuesday 02:00 UTC.
The customer contract clause changes the plan from no special notice to a customer-notification commitment for the affected named customers.
The audit policy changes log retention from 30 to exactly 180 days and changes ranking behavior from fully automated to requiring an enabled human-review path.
